items.name: Hoppers/Bins
items.description: Large conical or rectangular steel containers holding bulk clinker, gypsum, or fly ash above the feeding line.

items.name: Weigh feeders / Belt feeders
items.description: Horizontal conveyor belts with load cells, continuously measuring and controlling material flow rate.

items.name: Rotary feeders / Airlocks
items.description: Cylindrical housings with a rotating vane rotor that meters material while sealing air between zones.

items.name: Feed chute
items.description: Inclined enclosed duct or pipe guiding material directly into the mill inlet.
